title: Lunchline approach
description: Two halves: a tracked eyebrow, large light heading and lead paragraph on cream, beside a deep evergreen board with a typed title and a handwritten sum (a pale aside, a hooked arrow, terms and signs, a circled note, a double-underlined result). The heading's letters rise in, the board's lines wipe in from left to right one after another as you scroll, and the top hairline draws itself out.
notes: the board uses primary / primary-foreground and highlight for the pale aside, arrow and underline
the handwriting uses the theme's --typeface-hand when it has one (lunchline-theme: Reenie Beanie); with a wider display face, keep lines short
the wipe finishes while the board's lines sit in the lower half of the window, so leave something below it on the page
